text:
neha: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a compact action queue for rollout guards (auto-rollback + blast-radius caps). short sync: who owns what and timelines?

sam: I can own the auto-rollback work. summary goal: make rollback actionable at the feature-flag layer and have telemetry trigger. timeline: 2 sprints for infra + 1 sprint for validations.

jordan: I can pick up the blast-radius constraints (targeted rollout limits, per-route caps). will prototype a config schema this week.

kai: can we also add an emergency kill switch that bypasses complex checks? just a human-confirmed circuit breaker. i volunteer to spec the UI/ops flow.

maria: +1 on the kill switch. also need runbook updates and an oncall playbook snippet. i'll own docs and playbook edits.

sam: suggested approach:
- auto-rollback: metric-based rule set in rollout controller (error-rate, latency P95 spikes, model-quality drift).
- rollback action = toggle flag + traffic-shift to fallback model pool + alert oncall.

sam: rough config example to discuss:
```json
{
  "flag": "new-rerank-v2",
  "rules": [
    {"type": "error_rate", "window": "1m", "threshold": 0.02},
    {"type": "latency_p95", "window": "5m", "threshold_ms": 1200}
  ],
  "rollback_action": "switch_to:model:r1-stable",
  "escalation": ["oncall", "platform-lead"]
}
```

neha: that looks good. couple constraints: rollback action must be idempotent and visible in the audit log; prefer an async background job that flips flags and reconciliation loop verifies state.

jordan: question on blast-radius caps: do we limit by user count, org, region, or route? my proposal: primary dimension = route (api key) then secondary = region. org caps if customer-impacting.

kai: agree. route-level is simplest to enforce at the gateway. also add a soft-cap mode: allow exceeding by explicit approvers (for tests).

deploy-bot: deploy event: rollout-controller v0.9.3 promoted to staging at 1743654390 — smoke tests passed.

maria: action items (assignments + owners + due dates):
- A1: implement rollback controller integration (owner: sam) — due: 2024-06-14
- A2: schema + enforcement for blast-radius caps (owner: jordan) — due: 2024-06-07
- A3: emergency kill-switch design + ops flow (owner: kai) — due: 2024-05-31
- A4: runbook + alert playbook updates (owner: maria) — due: 2024-06-03
- A5: telemetry alert tuning + test harness (owner: sam + jordan) — due: 2024-06-10

sam: noting dependencies: rollback controller needs rollout telemetry (error/latency) from observability team. i'll open a tracking ticket and tag @observability.

neha: please add acceptance criteria to each action item before EOD tomorrow. quick checklist example:
- unit + integration tests for config parsing
- e2e test that triggers rollback via synthetic error injection
- audit log entry verified in kinesis

jordan: i'll add a sample enforcement policy and a CLI snippet for ops to adjust caps:
```bash
# set route cap to 2% traffic
ri rollout set-cap --route rerank --cap 0.02 --reason "postmortem mitigation"
```

kai: ops flow for kill-switch mockup: add two-step confirm (button + typed reason) and automatic rollback to last known-good snapshot. also add a TTL on manual overrides.

maria: recurring pattern note: this postmortem flagged 3 rollouts in last 6 months where lack of rollback + broad canaries amplified impact. we should add a quarterly audit for rollout configurations and a small dashboard that surfaces high-risk flags.

neha: agree — add A6: quarterly rollout-risk audit dashboard (owner: neha) — due: 2024-07-01. also add A7: create a lightweight 'canary health' smoke suite to run during rollouts (owner: sam) — due: 2024-06-12.

sam: I'll create the initial tickets and link the postmortem doc. tagging in the thread: @maria @jordan @kai for visibility.

maria: quick ask — who will do the verification run when rollback is triggered? we need a checklist for oncall to validate restoration.

neha: oncall verifies: 1) traffic reverted, 2) error rates back to baseline, 3) fallback model quality sanity check. if any fail, escalate to platform lead. i'll add that to the runbook.

jordan: timeline OK for me. I'll drop a PR with JSON schema and enforcement tests by end of week.

kai: will mock the UI flow and add screenshots to the doc.

deploy-bot: alert: synthetic rollback test scheduled for 1743654600 — will execute in staging bucket.

sam: final: i'll post a 1-pager with acceptance criteria + list of tickets by EOD. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: leaving this thread pinned to the incident channel and adding to the postmortem follow-up board.

neha: thanks team — we'll review progress in next week's SRE sync.
